title: USB Audio In
author: irpina
description: A stream from the computer into the Octatrack's inputs over its own USB port (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit), beside USB Audio Out in the same USB audio device: what it stands in for is a setting, USB AUDIO IN in the MODS menu (with the settings companion): OFF (the default), AB (channels 1-2 for inputs A/B), CD (for C/D) or ABCD (1-4 for A-D). It applies at the next power-up and needs a USB AUDIO LAYOUT other than OFF. It needs the DSP bus, which takes SPATIALIZER off the FX menus. Built on what sambanks/octabam's USB audio in found.
